messages.text: How should the lantern be cleaned?

Clean the glass before lighting it.

Three things matter:

- Wipe the soot off the inside of the chimney.
- Trim the wick so the flame burns evenly.
- Check the oil level against the mark.

The [manual](https://example.com/) has a diagram of the wick holder, and `trim --even` is the setting most people forget.
Once a week is enough for the chimney. The wick needs trimming every time the flame starts to smoke.
